new: 15 minutes per build by default, plus up to 5 more minutes for post-processing; a build that runs past the limit is stopped. A longer limit is not self-service in the web UI: the API accepts build_timelimit up to 1800 seconds (30 minutes) and Netlify Support sets longer ones (3600 seconds, one hour). Support replies disagree on who qualifies: a card on file, the Pro tier, or a Starter team raised to 30 minutes with no stated condition; for a credit-plan Free team it is unverified

evidence.quote: We can definitely bump your build timeout, but you’ll need to be on the Pro tier for us to make that change - that’s a requirement that applies to everyone who wants a bigger timeout.

evidence.proved: a later Netlify Support reply (2024-10-28) raised a Starter (legacy Free) team's build limit to 30 minutes with no Pro requirement
evidence.quote: For a Starter account, I’ve increased the build time limit to 30 minutes.

evidence.proved: a Netlify Support reply of 2023-09-26 asked a Starter team for a payment method on file before raising the build timeout
evidence.quote: Hi, in order to do this as you are on a starter account. Can you please add a payment method on file?
